jobs.description:
As an Imaging Engineer, you will contribute to the development and integration of imaging solutions for endoscope products. You will work with camera sensors, lenses, illumination and image-quality testing, supported by senior colleagues and cross-functional specialists in the medical device domain. The role combines practical laboratory work, technical problem-solving, supplier collaboration and structured documentation.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Contribute to the development of imaging technology, including sensor, optics and illumination in technology projects to build solid imaging solution roadmap.

• Participate in endoscope product-development projects, focusing on imaging component integration and imaging system performance, which include:

• Participate in user-related event and identify user need for imaging requirements.

• Support the selection and evaluation of sensors, lenses, illumination components and related imaging solutions.

• Assist with integration of imaging solutions into the product in collaboration with mechanical, electronics, quality and NPI engineers.

• Perform hands-on camera testing, image-quality evaluation, troubleshooting and documentation.

• Participate in user testing in clinical settings and provide imaging-related technical support.

• Prepare reports and technical documentation in line with medical-device development processes.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• A relevant degree in Optoelectronics, Electronics, Physics, Computer vision or a related engineering field.

• 2+ years of relevant professional experience. Strong graduates with practical project, internship or laboratory experience are also encouraged to apply.

• Basic understanding of camera systems and components such as image sensors, lenses, illumination and electronic interfaces.

• Familiarity with key imaging and optical performance concepts, for example SNR, dynamic range, noise, MTF, depth of field, field of view and distortion.

• Interest in hands-on testing, measurement, data analysis and systematic problem-solving.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering disciplines.

• A proactive approach to work and strong communication skills.

• A curious, structured and user-focused mindset with motivation to learn.

**Nice to have

**

• Exposure to ISP functions, camera calibration or imaging-pipeline tuning.

• Basic knowledge of mechanics, electronics or embedded camera systems.

• Practical use of laboratory equipment or image-quality measurement methods.

• Experience with Python programming and image/video analysis

**What You Will Gain

**

• Hands-on experience across the full imaging chain, from sensor and optics to illumination and image quality.

• Mentoring and technical guidance from experienced camera and product-development engineers.

• Opportunities to work with top-notch suppliers, prototypes, product teams and clinical users.

• A strong foundation for growing into an imaging specialist and imaging system-level engineering.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Are you a skilled Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer with experience across the full AI solution lifecycle, from model development and training to deployment and operation at scale? Do you enjoy combining deep technical expertise with practical, business-focused solutions that drive innovation and improve processes? If so, you could be our next Senior AI Engineer!

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of AI at JYSK by helping accelerate AI adoption across the organization. As part of a high-performing, agile AI Engineering team, you’ll contribute to our strategic ambition of integrating AI into business processes across the company. If you’re passionate about technical innovation and enjoy solving real-world business challenges with AI, we’d love to hear from you!

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A dynamic workplace in an international company focused on growth, innovation, and continuous development.

• A collaborative, open-minded environment with opportunities to engage across all organisational levels.

• A flexible work-from-home policy that supports a healthy work-life balance.

• Attractive employee benefits, including staff discounts across the Lars Larsen Group and a variety of social events throughout the year.

• Access to internal training, courses, and learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

• A welcoming and supportive culture, complemented by a comprehensive onboarding programme to help you succeed from day one.

• A low-politics, low-ego culture where collaboration, ownership, and high standards are valued.

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing AI solutions that drive innovation, enable data-driven decision-making, improve operations, and enhance customer experiences. You will bridge software engineering and machine learning, focusing on model experimentation, deployment, and integration to create scalable, efficient, and reusable solutions.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

• Develop and scale end-to-end AI applications and MLOps pipelines using your deep software engineering background.

• Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI agent systems, from orchestration and tool integration to production deployment and monitoring.

• Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embedding workflows, and semantic search solutions where appropriate.

• Research, experiment with, and develop classical and state-of-the-art AI models across NLP, Computer Vision, Deep Generative Models, Graph Neural Networks, and Reinforcement Learning to improve and optimize JYSK’s business processes.

• Collaborate closely with data, AI, and platform engineers on complex projects to integrate cutting-edge models into impactful AI products.

• Managing AI workloads on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ensure optimal performance and resource efficiency.

• Working with architects to refine AI solution design and contributing to solution planning phases.

• Supporting end-users of AI solutions with a "you build it, you own it" mindset.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• Holds a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field. A PhD is considered an advantage.

• Has 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering, designing and implementing AI solutions at scale using Python.

• Has a strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, with experience spanning both discriminative and generative models applied to structured data, natural language, and vision.

• Has experience developing, deploying, operating, and monitoring AI models in production at scale, preferably on Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent experience with Azure or AWS and a willingness to work with GCP).

• Has hands-on experience in one of the following areas: Building AI agents at scale integrated with advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Pre-training, fine-tuning, or post-training large language models (LLMs). Developing and deploying state-of-the-art generative AI solutions for computer vision in real-world environments.

• Works independently on complex technical challenges while collaborating effectively with stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Team Leader AI Engineering, Florencio Paucar at +45 27794325.

Send us a brief application with your CV by clicking “Apply”. We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

ABOUT US

We believe that our employees are key to our success going from one store in 1979 to more than 3,400 stores worldwide today. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing within JYSK, and we also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page**.

Do you want to help shape the future of data and analytics in a global MedTech company?

Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in our Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark and play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise-scale data solutions.

Working with modern Microsoft technologies and cloud-based solutions on Azure, you will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, system managers, and fellow data professionals to deliver impactful solutions that support critical business processes across our global organization.

This is a unique opportunity to combine your software engineering background with data engineering expertise while contributing to innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient care worldwide.

**The role

**As a Data Engineer, You Will Be Involved In The Design, Development And Support Of Solutions Across Ambu's Data Landscape, Including

• Enterprise Data Warehouse solutions

• Master Data Management (MDM) solutions

• Data integrations and APIs

• Cloud-based Azure data services

• Bespoke data solutions supporting various business functions

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Designing, developing and maintaining enterprise data solutions

• Building and supporting data integration pipelines and interfaces

• Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand and translate requirements into technical solutions

• Ensuring data quality, reliability and performance across the data platform

• Participating in project delivery, testing and solution deployment activities

• Supporting and enhancing existing data solutions

• Contributing to data governance, architecture and best practices

• Identifying opportunities to improve and modernize the data platform

**Suggested candidate profile

**Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a robust educational background in computer science, software engineering, data science, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience building and supporting data solutions in a modern cloud environment.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving complex business challenges through technology.

**More Specifically, You Bring

**

• Around 5 years of experience Data Engineering, Data Warehousing and Data Integration

• A background in Software Engineering and experience applying software development principles and best practices

• Strong SQL and data modelling skills

• Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and cloud services

• Experience developing ETL/ELT solutions, data pipelines, and integrations

• Knowledge of APIs and data integration patterns

• Understanding of Data Warehousing, Master Data Management (MDM), Data Quality, and Data Governance principles

• Experience with Python, C# or similar programming languages

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. **Summary

**At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

**Description

**We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable.

The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

**Responsibilities

**

• Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor or Postdoc in Economics and Business Economics
jobs.description:
The Department of Economics and Business Economics at Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University, is seeking ambitious and dedicated scholars to join a dynamic research and teaching environment. The positions offer excellent opportunities to develop an international research profile and contribute to high-quality teaching. We invite applications for one or more positions as assistant professor or postdoc in the field of economics and business economics.

The positions are full-time and different job packages can be offered including fixed-term postdoc and assistant professorships for up to 4 years. The starting date is 1 August 2027 or as soon as possible subject to mutual agreement.

Job description
As an assistant professor or postdoc, you are expected to make a significant contribution to our research and teaching activities and to support the further development of our overall research strategy.

You will teach and supervise students at both Bachelor's and Master's levels and conduct independent as well as collaborative research of the highest international standard. You are also expected to engage actively in the academic life of the department and contribute to the activities of the relevant research section

Your qualifications
You must have been awarded a PhD degree in economics and business economics or have acquired equivalent qualifications.

Who we are
At the Department of Economics and Business Economics, we aim to conduct research and teaching of the highest quality and impact. We believe that a supportive atmosphere and appreciative work environment are fundamental for our work and professional development. The department employs approximately 140 academic staff members and 55 PhD students, and our academic staff is highly international and culturally diverse. We focus on the recruitment of excellent national and international researchers. Our research and degree programmes have a strong international focus. The Department hosts a number of research centers and external funding for research activities has top priority. Read more about the department on our website www.econ.au.dk 

The Department of Economics and Business Economics is one of the six departments at Aarhus BSS, one of the five faculties at Aarhus University. Aarhus BSS unites the business and social science-related research fields and brings them closer together to reflect the close relationship between society and the business community. As part of a Top 100 university, Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations.

Further information
For further information about the position, please contact Head of Department, Professor Thomas Quistgaard Pedersen, tel.: +45 27467467, e-mail: tqpedersen@econ.au.dk

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR supporter Ulla P. Bjørn, e-mail: upb@au.dk.

Place of work
Aarhus University, Universitetsbyen 51, 8000 Aarhus C.

Are you an international applicant?
Aarhus University offers a wide range of services for international academic staff and their accompanying families, including relocation support and career counselling for accompanying partners. Find more information here: Relocation Service at Aarhus University

Learn more about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: Aarhus University research

Aarhus University also offers a career development programme for postdocs and assistant professors. Read more about the programme here: Junior Researchers

Terms of employment
The appointment is made in accordance with the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities as well as the circular on the Collective Agreement for Academics Employed by the State (in Danish). The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement for academics in the state sector. You will be employed as assistant professor or postdoc at basic salary level 4–8, with supplements in accordance with the protocol on certain terms of employment for academic staff at universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• Cover letter. You are encouraged to elaborate on your current and future research plans and on how you match the department’s profile, including potential research centers.
• Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave or career breaks without research activity, including, for example, parental leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time.
• Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree).
• List of publications, working papers, and work-in-progress (the enclosed papers must be clearly marked on the list of publications).
• Publications. Up to three papers, including both publications and working papers, may be submitted. In the event of co-authors the included papers must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning your share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors.This template may be used for the purpose
• Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here.
Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here.

The evaluation process
After the application deadline, an assessment committee is appointed. Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline. For further information, see Guidelines for Assessment Committee, Aarhus BSS. 

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website. 

Aarhus University
Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment to its 38,000 students (FTEs) and 8,300 employees, and has an annual revenues of EUR 935 million. Learn more at https://international.au.dk//

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Clinical Genetics Data Scientist, you will turn human genetic evidence into clear recommendations that guide clinical development decisions. You will lead defined projects that combine trial and population genetic data with clinical outcomes and molecular measurements. Your work will help explain disease biology, understand why people respond differently to treatment and identify where patient stratification, or asset differentiation could matter. It helps teams decide with confidence, for people living with serious chronic diseases.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an independent, systematic scientist with sound judgement, who communicates uncertainty openly, acts on feedback and sees work through to its outcome.

• A PhD in statistical genetics, genetic epidemiology, bioinformatics or a related quantitative discipline; or a relevant master’s degree with equivalent demonstrated research and applied experience.

• Demonstrated independent ownership of complex human genetics projects, from study design and data preparation to robust interpretation and communication of results.

• Strong, hands-on experience in GWAS design, execution and interpretation, including linkage disequilibrium, population structure, relatedness, multiple testing, power and validation.

• Proficiency in R and/or Python, Linux and genetics tools such as PLINK, BCFtools, GATK, REGENIE, SAIGE or equivalent, with reproducible programming, version control, documentation and quality review.

• Practical experience processing SNP array and WGS data, including quality control, genotype harmonisation, phasing and imputation, variant calling, filtering and functional annotation.

• Hands-on experience conducting and interpreting pQTL analyses, including cis and trans mapping, multiple-testing control and integration with GWAS or colocalisation evidence.

• The ability to coordinate stakeholders, manage project risks and dependencies, and present complex findings clearly in English to audiences with different technical backgrounds.

**Desirable, But Not Essential

**Experience in clinical trial genetics, pharmacogenetics or clinical development, particularly in cardiometabolic, obesity or renal disease; rare-variant and gene-based tests, genetic risk prediction or advanced causal inference; or work with secure cloud computing, biobank-scale resources and regulated analytical environments.

**What You’ll Do

**You will own project outcomes from the scientific question to validated results and practical recommendations.

• Plan and run GWAS, pQTL and related analyses of disease phenotypes, clinical endpoints, biomarkers and treatment response, using trial and external cohort data.

• Prepare SNP array and whole-genome sequencing data into analysis-ready datasets, and use fine-mapping, colocalisation and causal inference to prioritise plausible variants, genes, pathways and biomarkers.

• Investigate pharmacogenetic associations and genetically informed subgroups, separating prognostic signals from evidence of differential treatment benefit.

• Turn findings into decision-focused reports and presentations, with clear uncertainty and limitations, and contribute genetics content to publications and regulatory documents.

• Build documented, version-controlled workflows, mentor colleagues through code review and feedback, and use genetic and clinical data within approved consent, governance and quality requirements.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Clinical Omics Sciences, part of Translational & Clinical Omics in Research & Development. Here, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing, bringing together curiosity, data, technology and collaboration.

Your closest partners will be Clinical Development Teams, translational scientists, human genetics researchers, biostatisticians, data managers and data engineers. You will also coordinate agreed work with external collaborators and suppliers. You will explain your technical choices in accessible language, build alignment on the question, deliverables and decision, and speak up early when something stalls.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to determine and execute the analytical approach for your projects, within agreed objectives and quality requirements. You will be supported to perform at your best, make your voice heard and grow through practical project experience, scientific feedback and relevant learning offerings. You will also help raise the standard for the whole team by shaping shared workflows, templates and methods.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to

956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. Please apply by 27 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

We seek an experienced, highly motivated, and independent laboratory technician to support the Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Design (CPD) at the University of Copenhagen (UCPH). This is a full-time position, starting as soon as possible, and employment through 31 July 2032.

  Our research:

  The CPD is a multidisciplinary centre that works across the university—notably with the Departments of Biology, Drug Design and Pharmacology, Chemistry, and Computer Science—and with national and international academic and industrial partners. CPD is funded by an initial grant of 700M DKK for seven years from the Novo Nordisk Foundation. At capacity, the CPD is expected to have ≈8 research groups, ≈80 researchers, and support staff. Research will encompass the growing protein design landscape with computational, experimental, applied and hybrid projects.

  The CPD's vision and mission are to accelerate protein design by deepening understanding of sequence-to-structure/function relationships in proteins, and to train the next generation of protein scientists to apply protein-design approaches and methods to a diverse array of fundamental and real-world challenges.  

  CPD research is broadly organised into three themes: Programmable De Novo Protein Design, aimed at improving methods for protein design by combining rational, physics-based and AI-based approaches; Contextualised Protein Design, which is about designing proteins that are fit for purpose, such as working directly and optimally in cells, chemical reactors, etc.; and Biodesign for Sustainability and Healthcare, for instance working with biotech and industry to deliver synthetic proteins to address grand challenges in these areas.

  Further information on the CPD see: cpd.ku.dk.

  Your job:

  Specifically, we seek a talented laboratory technician and team player to help set up, equip and support research in newly refurbished labs. You will join the CPD Operations and Management Team, work closely with another laboratory technician and the CPD Experimental Officer, and fulfil a key role supporting CPD researchers.

  Tasks of the Laboratory Technician will include:

   	
• Assist in setting up, establishing, and organising newly refurbished CPD laboratories together with a laboratory technician and the CPD Experimental Officer. 	
• Order, track, and manage laboratory supplies, consumables, and chemical inventory, including invoice processing. 	
• Solicit and evaluate quotes from multiple vendors for large equipment purchases in accordance with university and public procurement guidelines. 	
• Process purchase orders, verify deliveries, monitor invoices, and register new equipment. 	
• Serve as a key contributor to safety compliance, chemical registration, and risk assessment coordination. 	
• Drive and maintain environmental sustainability initiatives in KU, targeting LEAF (Laboratory Efficiency Assessment Framework) 	
• Establish and maintain rigorous safety routines, waste management and documentation. 	
• Contribute to onboarding new researchers, visiting scientists, and students, including safety introductions, lab space allocation, and workflow introductions. 	
• Contribute to the offboarding processes by ensuring proper handover of samples and data and chemical/waste disposal. 	
• Prepare shared stock solutions and reagents 	
• Contribute to practical laboratory classes and guide new researchers on standard operating procedures.   Profile:

  To succeed in this role, we anticipate that you have a lab technician (laborant) degree or similar. We also expect you to be a service-minded team player who likes managing the day-to-day operation of a laboratory, including carrying out administrative tasks like obtaining quotations and handling purchasing and procurement activities.

  Preferably, you have experience with hands-on expertise in solid-phase peptide synthesis and peptide purification, solid knowledge of biochemistry laboratory safety regulations, and a keen interest in collaborating with researchers from different backgrounds. You should bring a strong motivation for optimising lab organisation and safety, alongside a genuine interest in teaching students and guiding new researchers within a dynamic, international academic environment.

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• Highly structured, detail-oriented, and able to prioritise and execute tasks independently 	
• Knowledge of biochemical and/or chemical research and teaching laboratories 	
• Understanding of Good Laboratory Practice, chemical and biological safety regulations, standard documentation practices, and inventory management 	
• Strong and proven organisational, communication, and networking skills 	
• Good written and spoken Danish and English language skills   Desirable experience and skills

   	
• Experience with solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS) and peptide purification 	
• Experience with Kemibrug, SDI and RejsUd 	
• Experience with the LEAF or similar green laboratory sustainability programmes 	
• Perform routine recombinant protein expression and purification to generate shared stocks 	
• Experience with mammalian cell lines and preparing bacterial competent cells   Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the NNF Center for Protein Design, located at the Department of Drug Design and Pharmacology, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative, stimulating working conditions in a dynamic, international research environment.

  Terms of salary and employment
 The employment as a laboratory technician (TAP) is a full-time (37 hours/week) position with employment through 31 July 2032. The starting date is as soon as possible, and, ideally, the successful candidate will be in place by March 2027 to coincide with the preparations for opening newly refurbished labs.

  Employment will be in accordance with the provisions of the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and HK Stat, Organisationsaftalen for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector on this page Lønoverblik

  The monthly salary will be based on of work experience, with the possibility to negotiate a salary supplement based on prior experience and qualifications.

  Questions
 For further information regarding the position, please contact CPD Experimental Officer, Ana Almeida, ana.almeida@sund.ku.dk.

  Learn more about the Department of Drug Design and Pharmacology, https://drug.ku.dk/, and Center for Protein Design https://cpd.ku.dk/

  Application
 Your application should be in English and include:

   	
• A cover letter outlining your fit to the role and motivation for applying (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum Vitae (incl. the names of two references (max. two pages)  	
• A certified/signed copy of certificate(s) of education   Please submit your application by clicking on “Apply Now” below. Only online applications will be accepted.

  Application deadline: 4 January 2027, 23:59 [CET]

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not meet the above requirements.

  Interviews are expected to be held in January 2027.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion, or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

  As part of the International Alliance of Research Universities (IARU) and among Europe’s top-ranking universities, the University of Copenhagen promotes research and teaching to the highest international standard. Rich in tradition and modern in outlook, the University gives students and staff the opportunity to cultivate their talent in an ambitious and informal environment. An effective organisation – with good working conditions and a collaborative work culture – creates the ideal framework for a successful academic career.

jobs.occupation: 800xA System Specialist to Life Science Automation
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Engineering Manager

__

**Your Role And Responsibilities

**Do you have extensive experience with System 800xA and a strong background in troubleshooting complex process plants? Are you ready to take on a key specialist role where you define automation architecture and develop advanced technical solutions for our customers?

If so, this is your opportunity to make a significant technical impact within ABB’s Life Science business.

ABB delivers large-scale 800xA systems to leading Pharma and Life Science customers in Denmark. The success of these projects is driving a growing pipeline, and you will play a central role in shaping future opportunities. As a technical lead, you will contribute to development projects and work closely with our business development team on upcoming initiatives.

In this role, you will collaborate with ABB engineers, project managers, and service account managers across multiple customer projects in Life Science production environments. As a System 800xA specialist, you will take ownership of complex troubleshooting, guide architectural decisions, and identify optimal solutions.

With your deep expertise in System 800xA, automation architecture, and process control libraries, you will solve high-complexity challenges that others cannot – both for customers and their sub-suppliers.

You can be based in Ballerup, Kalundborg, or Middelfart. However, you should expect to be on-site with customers in Bagsværd and/or Kalundborg at least one day per week, with increased presence during critical project phases.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Coordination with relevant internal ABB functions for resolution of complex technical issues for customers.

• Diagnose and troubleshoot on technical issues - evaluation of problem descriptions, analysis of log files, remote diagnostics in installed base, etc.

• Take the lead in maturing and developing architecture for new projects.

• Consult the customer with the right solutions based on technical knowledge and support from ABB organization.

• Develop, test, document and PoC in technical solutions and support your colleagues in executing.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in 800xA with AC800M process in larger size process automation projects.

• In depth experience with 800xA system and control libraries (e.g. PCDL, PCEL) from troubleshooting and development

• Solid experience with test, commissioning, and hypercare phases of an automation project, and familiar with typical issues raised during these phases.

• Experience from ABB R&D organization is an advantage.

• Experience within Life Science industries and batch management is an advantage.

• Ability to understand customer requirements and challenges with a service-minded approach.

• Experience in working either within or together with the L3 support team or L4 R&D.

• Demonstrating ownership, applying a problem-solving solution-oriented mindset and strong communication skills.

**More About Us

**At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization with very good well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability.

When you join ABB, you become part of a global, world-leading technology company known for innovation, quality, and opportunity. In ABB’s Life Science organization, you will be part of a highly successful business with a strong brand, a clear strategy, and an exciting project pipeline for the coming years. Equally important, you will enjoy a positive work environment characterized by respect, helpfulness, and a supportive tone.

You will be part of our Life Science Engineering team, collaborating with experienced engineers. We are an international group of approx. 50 project engineers in Denmark. In addition, we collaborate with +50 colleagues from the global ABB organization.

You will have a fixed base in our office in Ballerup, Kalundborg or Middelfart, where most of your close colleagues are also based. We also offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week.

The position reports to Engineering Manager, Lars Schultz.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also save selected jobs. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Lars Schultz at +45 2497 8635. You can also find more information about us on our website www.abb.com.

The application deadline is 08.12.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

_ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable future with efficient use of resources. By connecting our knowledge in engineering and digitalization, ABB makes industry more efficient, productive, sustainable and able to improve their performance. At ABB, we call it 'Engineered to Outrun'. The company has over 140 years of history and more than 105,000 employees worldwide. In Denmark, you will have more than 500 colleagues in offices in Ballerup, Middelfart, Esbjerg, Kalundborg and Aalborg.

__Join us. Be part of the team where progress takes place, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World.

__#RunWithABB

_Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At BlinkTroll, we’re building next-generation training systems and defense technology used by military and police forces across Europe. Our mission is simple but urgent: to support the defenders of the free world with powerful, practical, and life-saving technology.

We’re looking for an Electronics Engineer to join our team in Odense, someone who can work independently, communicate clearly across disciplines, and take ownership of electronics from the first block diagram to a tested board in the field.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving real problems, building robust hardware for tough conditions, and working closely with a small team of mechanical, software, and embedded engineers.

What You’ll Do

• Design electronics from requirements and architecture to component selection and schematics

• Create PCB layouts (Altium Designer or KiCad) with focus on signal integrity, power, thermal performance and EMC

• Build prototypes, bring up new boards and debug hardware together with embedded engineers

• Plan and carry out verification, environmental and EMC pre-compliance testing

• Prepare production files (Gerber, BOM, assembly drawings) and work with PCB and EMS partners

• Work closely with mechanical engineers on integration, board space and enclosures

• Take full ownership of design documentation, component libraries and version control

• Manage component lifecycle, obsolescence and second sources to keep products buildable

• Contribute ideas and improvements to system architecture and product design

Who You Are

• 5–10 years of hands-on experience developing electronics, from schematic to series production

• Degree in electronics, electrical engineering or a related field

• Experienced in schematic design and multilayer PCB layout in Altium Designer or KiCad

• Solid skills in analog, digital and power electronics, including microcontroller designs and common interfaces (SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, USB, Ethernet)

• Hands-on with board bring-up and debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analysers and other lab equipment

• Understanding of EMC/EMI and designing for manufacturing

• Nice to have: battery-powered or ruggedised products, RF/wireless, or defense/industrial standards (MIL-STD, IP ratings, CE marking)

• Reliable, structured, and comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment

• Based in or near Odense, or willing to work on-site

• Eligible for security clearance

What We Offer

• Work on technology with real-world impact

• A hands-on engineering environment in Odense’s robotics and defense ecosystem

• A small, ambitious team where your ideas matter

• Direct influence on product and technical direction

• Freedom to choose and improve your tools, including Altium or KiCad

• Strong team culture

• Opportunity to grow with the company

Job Title: Library and Digital Media Officer

Job Type: Part-time (with possibility of full-time conversion) | Workplace: Copenhagen, Denmark | Employer: China Cultural Center in Copenhagen

 

About the Organization

The China Cultural Center in Copenhagen is an official institution dedicated to promoting cultural and tourism exchanges between China and Denmark at both governmental and grassroots levels. We organize cultural events, facilitate people-to-people exchanges, and collaborate with Danish institutions and travel trade partners to enhance mutual understanding and cooperation.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced professional to join our team and to serve as an important communication window for promoting Chinese culture to Danish and international audiences.

 

Job Description

The Library and Digital Media Officer is responsible for the management and operation of the China Cultural Center's digital media platforms and library, as well as the promotion of the Center's cultural activities and public services.

 

Key Responsibilities

 ⑴ Social Media Management and Digital Communications

Manage and maintain the Center's social media accounts and digital platforms, including WeChat Official Account, Facebook, Instagram and the Center's official website. 

Plan, create, edit and publish communication materials, including news articles, event announcements, promotional posts, photographs, videos and other digital content.

Develop and implement social media content plans in accordance with the Center's events and communication objectives.

Monitor platform performance, analyse engagement and audience data, and continuously improve content quality and online visibility.

Coordinate photography, video recording, editing and the archiving of promotional materials for the Center's activities.

 ⑵ Library Management and Public Services

Oversee the daily operations of the Center's library, including book classification, cataloguing, registration, lending, returns and collection management.

Establish and maintain library management procedures and reader services, including opening arrangements, reservations and visitor reception.

Actively promote the opening of the library to the general public and expand its readership among local residents and communities.

Plan and organise reading promotion activities, book-sharing sessions, cultural talks and other public cultural activities.

Promote the library's resources and services to increase its visibility and accessibility within the local community.

⑶ Cultural Communications and General Support

Support the promotion and publicity of the Center's cultural events, exhibitions, performances, lectures and cultural exchange activities.

Photograph cultural events and create visual content for the Center's promotional and communication purposes.

Participate in developing communication strategies, preparing promotional materials, writing copy and producing multimedia content.

Assist in establishing and maintaining relationships with local communities, schools, cultural institutions and other relevant organisations to expand partnerships and promote public cultural services.

Undertake other related duties as assigned by the Center.

 

Essential:

1. Language: Fluent proficiency in both Chinese and English (written and spoken).

2. Industry Knowledge: Professional knowledge of social media management and digital platform operations. Proficiency in using standard office software and applications.

3. Paper Work Ability: written communication and analytical reporting skills.

4. Education: Bachelor's degree or above.

5. Background Check: An acceptable criminal record check is required and Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark.

6. Health: Ability to provide a health certificate as required by the employer.

 

Preferred:

1. Proficiency in Danish is a strong advantage.

 

Work Authorization

During the interview stage, candidates will be asked to confirm their current residence status in Denmark. For positions involving international travel, verification of legal work authorization may be required prior to final offer.

 

Selection Process & Interview

To apply for this position, please submit the following to our email:

① Your CV/resume;

② A written proposal outlining how you would develop and manage the media and digital communication platforms of the China Cultural Center in Copenhagen.

 (format: Word or PDF)

 

Selection Timeline:

1. Applications will be screened on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

2. If you have not received an email response by 31 December, 2026, please assume that your application has not been shortlisted for an interview.

 

Special Terms of Employment

This position starts on a part-time basis. The Center may offer a one-year full-time contract, based on work performance and business needs. The final interpretation of these employment terms shall reside with the Center.

 

Contact for Applications

China Cultural Center in Copenhagen

Email:[info@ccccph.org]

Subject line for applications: "Library and Digital Media Officer – [Your Name]"

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Mechatronic Design for Remotely Operated Vehicles
jobs.description:
Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites application for an 18-month postdoc position within Mechatronic Design for Remotely Operated Vehicles (ROVs). The position is available from March 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed upon with the successful candidates.

 

What we offer 

Successful candidates will join an interdisciplinary engineering research environment at SDU Sønderborg and contribute to the development of ROVs and associated subsea mechatronics. The work combines engineering design, numerical modelling, prototyping, fabrication, integration, and experimental validation in laboratory and marine environments.

The positions offer opportunities to:

• 
Develop and evaluate mechatronic components, subsystems, and integrated ROV platforms.

• 
Design underwater actuation mechanisms, transmissions, structural components, and pressure-resistant enclosures, including sealing and mechanical interfaces.

• 
Integrate underwater sensors, actuators, embedded electronics, and control hardware.

• 
Perform CAD modelling, engineering analysis, simulations, design optimisation, and prototype fabrication.

• 
Conduct laboratory and field testing to improve the performance, reliability, and robustness of subsea mechatronic technologies.

• 
Publish research in international scientific journals and conferences, collaborate with research partners, and contribute to student supervision where relevant.

 

What we expect 

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, robotics, marine engineering, or a closely related discipline at the time of employment. We seek motivated researchers with strong mechatronic design skills and hands-on experience in developing, integrating, and testing electromechanical systems.

Applicants should have demonstrated expertise in mechatronic design and practical experience in several of the following areas:

• 
Mechanical and mechatronic design, including actuation, transmissions, structural design, and electromechanical integration.

• 
CAD and engineering modelling or analysis, such as finite element analysis, multibody dynamics, or related methods.

• 
Integration of sensors, actuators, embedded electronics, and control hardware.

• 
Rapid prototyping, additive manufacturing, machining, assembly, and experimental development.

• 
Experimental testing, instrumentation, data acquisition, system characterisation, and troubleshooting.

• 
Basic programming and control using tools such as Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink, or ROS/ROS 2.

Experience in subsea engineering, ROV development, underwater actuation, pressure-resistant enclosures, waterproofing, sealing, or marine instrumentation is an advantage but not a requirement. Applicants should have a publication record appropriate to their career stage, sound scientific judgement, good written and spoken English, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

 

Workplace description 

The positions will be based at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), Department of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, in Sønderborg. The research environment brings together expertise in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, modelling, control, and experimental engineering.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Sønderborg. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact:

• 
Lars Duggen, Head of Unit, SDU Mechatronics (CIM), at duggen@sdu.dk

• 
Mrudul Chellapurath, Assistant Professor, at mrch@sdu.dk

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications highlighting the publications most relevant to the position.

• 
A research statement.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 18-month period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time of registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering. Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Sønderborg.
